primitives.name: Dispatcher
primitives.summary: Reads a shell command once and spawns each guard only where the command could trip it.

primitives.name: Guard library
primitives.summary: The shell library every guard sources: payload reader, scanners, quote mask, launcher table, git readers, refusal.

primitives.name: Dangerous commands guard
primitives.summary: Refuses what the reflog cannot bring back, bare force and protected-branch pushes, remote deletes, rm aimed at a root.

primitives.name: Env access guard
primitives.summary: Judges an env file read by guardrails.envFiles: the deny list, the allow list, then the policy, git by default.

primitives.name: Credential leak guard
primitives.summary: Refuses reads of credential stores outside dotenv, credential-ish env dumps, and a curl or wget carrying one.

primitives.name: Package manager guard
primitives.summary: Refuses npm, npx, yarn and bun where the resolved packageManagers.node is pnpm; silent in every other repository.

primitives.name: Store writes guard
primitives.summary: Refuses every write to App Store Connect: an asc verb that is not a read, a store script without --confirm.

primitives.name: Commit hygiene guard
primitives.summary: Holds a subject to commit.pattern or the convention, requires commit.trailer, refuses git add -A and git add .

primitives.name: Large file guard
primitives.summary: Flags a file over 256 KiB once a Write lands it; advisory, CLAUDE_MAX_WRITE_BYTES is its one switch.

primitives.name: rtk rewrite
primitives.summary: Wires rtk hook claude from the plugin; silent without rtk, and git in a linked worktree goes through unrewritten.

primitives.name: Guardrails session hook
primitives.summary: Tells the first turn what no file says: a missing jq, an invalid config layer, a linked worktree still to set up.

primitives.name: References session hook
primitives.summary: Runs the Sync at startup and prints its lines; a repository without the references key gets no output.

primitives.name: Commit-msg hook
primitives.summary: The subject check as a git commit-msg hook, so a commit typed in a terminal meets it; wired from .husky/commit-msg.

primitives.name: Agentic config
primitives.summary: How a repository works for an agent: a committed file, a local layer over it, both against the schema.

primitives.name: Config resolver
primitives.summary: Reads, validates and merges the layers, in TypeScript for the scripts and in jq for the guards, one behaviour.

primitives.name: guardrails key
primitives.summary: forcePush, commitOnProtected, protectedBranches and envFiles; a local layer may only tighten them.

primitives.name: commit key
primitives.summary: The convention or pattern a commit subject follows and the trailer every commit carries.

primitives.name: packageManagers key
primitives.summary: The Node package manager a repository works with, inferred from the lockfile when nothing sets it.

primitives.name: validation key
primitives.summary: The commands that verify a change, a list skills read and no script runs; the gate key of ADR 0009 takes its place.

primitives.name: worktree key
primitives.summary: The commands a fresh worktree still needs; the session hook names them in a linked worktree.

primitives.name: references key
primitives.summary: The References a repository reads: dir, repository, ref, skipped paths, what and when; the references plugin owns it.

primitives.name: Guardrails setup
primitives.summary: Writes a machine's local config, excludes, settings deny rules and the lease-push exception; only what would change.

primitives.name: Doctor
primitives.summary: One PASS, WARN, FAIL or INFO line per machine check; installs nothing and exits 1 on a FAIL.

primitives.name: Sync
primitives.summary: Brings every declared Reference to its ref, shallow and sparse; a clone with local edits is reported and left alone.

primitives.name: References setup
primitives.summary: Makes a repository ready for References: the Router with its table from the key, the excludes, the ignore rules.

primitives.name: sdlc-guardrails-setup
primitives.summary: The user-invoked skill that runs the setup as a dry run, then for real, then the doctor.

primitives.name: sdlc-references-add
primitives.summary: The user-invoked skill that runs the setup, writes one Reference's entry into the key and syncs its dir.

primitives.name: Marketplace
primitives.summary: The catalogue Claude Code installs the plugins from, this repository's own; one enabledPlugins line installs one.

primitives.name: guardrails plugin
primitives.summary: The manifest wiring each guard and hook to its event; its version and the marketplace's bump together.

primitives.name: references plugin
primitives.summary: The manifest wiring the session hook; its version and the marketplace's bump together.

primitives.name: pnpm check
primitives.summary: The Gate: lint, format, typecheck, the Router check and tests as one command, the same in a terminal and in CI.

primitives.name: Pre-commit hook
primitives.summary: lint-staged over the staged files, oxlint --fix and oxfmt, before the commit-msg hook judges the subject.

primitives.name: Dependabot
primitives.summary: Grouped npm and GitHub Actions updates once a week, each 7 days after its release.
